$comment: Positive half of the man-011/man-012 pair pinning the ECMA-262 reading of the capability pattern (#176 item 21). U+0085 (NEXT LINE) is not white space under ECMA-262 and is accepted; some other regex dialects treat it as white space. The second capability is written with a JSON escape so the code point is visible.
description: A Manifest offering a capability string that contains U+0085. The capability pattern excludes exactly the ECMA-262 white-space and line-terminator code points listed in registries/capabilities.md, and U+0085 is not one of them. Verification MUST succeed.

expected.rationale: U+0085 is outside the excluded set, so the Manifest is schema-valid; version, PoP, signature and expiry all pass. A verifier whose regex dialect counts U+0085 as white space rejects this Manifest and is non-conformant.
